missions.title: The Job Interview
missions.desc: Mikiko is handing out flyers for Kitsune's Farm.

lines.t: Year 100. Mikiko's second day in the new world. He's looking for farm workers.
Hey! I'm Mikiko. You looking for a job? Good old farm work - cutting grass, selling fruit.
lines.group: Hey! I'm Mikiko. Y'all looking for work? Good old farm work - cutting grass, selling fruit.

lines.t: ...Sure.
And me! Zane the Magical Mage! I need money to harness my magical power!
Magic, huh? Where I'm from we call that Karma. Watch - fire!
INCREDIBLE!! You must teach me!
Interview's tomorrow, 12:00 at the farm. See y'all there.
Welcome. I'm Kitsune. Next - you. State what you can do.
lines.group: Welcome. I'm Kitsune. You lot - state what you can do.

lines.t: ...I can fight.
(Hm. Decent Karma.) Good. The land has gangs and wild animals on it.
lines.sky: (A Skylander? Strong Karma.) Good. The land has gangs and wild animals on it.

lines.t: Behold my spell!
That's cute. Incomplete, but cute. You're both hired.
lines.group: That's cute. Incomplete, but cute. You're all hired.

lines.t: Fox Gi- I mean Kitsune hired another worker? Nice. Welcome to the farm!
lines.group: Fox Gi- I mean Kitsune hired more workers? Nice. Welcome to the farm!

lines.t: First job: clear the freeloaders off my land. Call it training.

steps.obj: Clear the gangs and wild animals off the farmland

missions.title: The Farmland Rap Battle
missions.desc: Two brothers won't get off the farmland - unless someone beats them in a rap battle.

lines.t: 2nd week at the farm and... this sucks.
Remember what Kitsune said - it's training! ...Wait, you hear that? A gang!
Steve, you can't set up here. It's OUR turf.
I challenge you, Garry! ...To a rap off!
Wait... what?!
You're on our farmland! I challenge you - if I lose I'll never rap again! I'm Zane the mythical and magical creature, I'm the one who's going to beat ya.
Who let him cook! ...You lost, mage.
My rap career is over. {You}, it's up to you!
lines.group: My rap career is over. Somebody - it's up to you!

lines.t: Alright new kid. I'm Purple Stevie and you best believe me, I'll win this rap today - go!

choice.text: "Your bars are borrowed, your brother wrote 'em first."
"I'm on the farm, I plant seeds, you're the weeds."

reply.t: OH SNAP! Because it's a FARM!

lines.t: I got this. I'm Mikiko, the Fox King, the one that brings fire - next time I see you, I'll hand you a job application!
Nah, that was cold. Y'all won fair and square. We'll leave.
Fun battle though, yo.

missions.title: Opening Day
missions.desc: Kitsune's Farm Store opens. Everyone and their mama shows up - and so do the pests.

lines.t: MIKIKO! Restock! {You}, the fields - something's eating my crops!
lines.group: MIKIKO! Restock! You all, the fields - something's eating my crops!

lines.t: On it.

steps.obj: Drive the pests out of the fields

missions.title: Long Time No See
missions.desc: Someone's following Mikiko and Zane on the way back.

lines.t: Zane. Go back to the store. Someone's following us. Tell Fox Girl.
Long time no see... Mikiko. I'm free from your blade now. And I want to kill you.
No Hekublade? Fine - I've got these hands. Manifest greatness!!
Don't worry, I handled the rest. Scared the soul right out of him.
I was gone like ten seconds!
And you grabbed a book transporter from the Elementalist School? That enrolls you. Have fun at school.
NO! I don't wanna go back to school!!

missions.title: The Elementalist School
missions.desc: First day of class. The teachers are... ghosts?

lines.t: I came from a sky island. Found this school flying around. I'm a 2nd year!
Today: Recarnagans and Memory Chasers. Then Elemental Modifications. To finish D rank early - control an element.
Wait... that's it? Watch this.
Wow, great job Mikiko. And you, new student - show me.
lines.group: Wow, great job Mikiko. And you new students - show me.

steps.obj: Show the teacher your element: break the targets

lines.t: Excellent. You don't have to come back until next year.
...I can't use my element yet. Henery, guess we'll help each other.

missions.title: The Haunted Halls
missions.desc: Something real is hiding behind the school's fake ghosts.

lines.t: The ghosts are fake, to scare people off... but THAT one isn't. {You}, help!
lines.group: The ghosts are fake, to scare people off... but THOSE aren't. Help!

steps.obj: Clear the real threats out of the school
Possessed in both wings - Zane takes the other one

missions.title: A New Hekublade
missions.desc: A powerful man is coming for the village. Mikiko needs his blade - and Rhalix.

lines.t: Someone stronger than you and Rhalix broke out of a Government facility. He's coming here.
So... I made you a new Hekublade. Better than the last. Making it took my power - I can't help you fight.
You could've beaten him THEN made it!
...Yeah, I guess. Go find Rhalix. Take our new worker.
lines.group: ...Yeah, I guess. Go find Rhalix. Take the new workers.

lines.t: *grabs gear*

steps.obj: The C-Souls are after the Hekublade - fight them off

lines.t: Don't worry Mikiko, I got your back!
Rhalix! I was waiting for you to jump in! This one works the farm with me.
lines.group: Rhalix! I was waiting for you to jump in! These guys work the farm with me.

lines.t: Farm work? Haha. Xeno Warrior reunion battle - winner's leader!
...and then a Government car pulled up. But that's another story.
